selection: first indented tuple in the pinned committed text log, no fallback or tuple search

model.stream: d_i=primer_i for i0..5; d_i=(d_(i-5)+d_(i-6)) mod16 for i6..96
model.alphabets: p_value and c_value independent full bijections A-Z to0..25
model.direction: plaintext-to-ciphertext addition, direct unchanged one-based crib alignment; no transposition, rephase, reversal or reset

algorithm.graph: observed P-letter and C-letter nodes, edge P->C offset d_i and inverse edge offset-d_i mod26. Sort roots by (side,letter), C before P, and adjacency by target/offset/input-index; each component root potential0.
algorithm.local_filter: verify all cycle offsets and distinct same-side potentials inside every connected component
algorithm.global: Assign each component a translation t in0..25. Enforce all-different on observed P values across components and separately C values. Fix component0 translation0 (global additive gauge).
algorithm.search: deterministic forward checking; choose unassigned component with fewest legal translations, tie by larger observed node count then root order; offsets increasing; stop at first witness or exact exhaustion
algorithm.completion: fill unobserved letters in alphabetical order with unused values ascending independently on each side; verify both full permutations and all24edge equations
algorithm.roundtrip: if satisfiable, decode97 and re-encrypt exactly under this arbitrary witness; verify24cribs, emit no full K4 plaintext. This is algebraic feasibility, not meaningful plaintext recovery or solution evidence.

toy_oracle.method: independent direct enumeration of all P/C permutation pairs; compare existence and independently validate any solver witness

plants.checks: planted full alphabets encrypt synthetic message, solver must return SAT; verify returned full bijections/known equations and full decode/regeneration; require original plaintext recovery only when all97known

negative_controls: cross-component global obstruction despite local filter success

stopping: Exactly one published tuple; no new source sweep. Stop at verified SAT/UNSAT or explicit unresolved budget. No claim about other survivors or Gromark generally.
provenance: Published tuple/model read before spec; no local feasibility calculation before commit. This is independent implementation, not execution of source scripts.
